Version 0.5.1 • MIT License

## THE CODEBASE   
KNOWLEDGE GRAPH

A powerful CLI toolkit and MCP server that instantly indexes your local code into a fully navigable graph for AI assistants.

4352 Stars

•

843 Forks

•

Loading stats...

## See CodeGraphContext in Action

Watch how CodeGraphContext transforms complex codebases into interactive knowledge graphs.

Experience the next generation of AI‑powered code understanding with graph‑based intelligence.

| Feature | C | R | CodeGraphContext |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Smart Code Completion | ✓Strong | ✓Strong | ✓Strong |
| Dependency Tracking | ✕No | ✕No | ✓Direct + Multi‑hops |
| Context‑Aware Refactoring | ▲Limited | ▲Limited | ✓Via dependency tracing |
| Deep Codebase Understanding | ✕Limited | ▲Partial | ✓Graph‑based analysis |
| Cross‑Repository Navigation | ✕Very low | ▲Some | ✓Complete code view |
| AI Explanation Quality | ✕Low | ▲Hallucinated | ✓Extremely accurate |
| Scalable Performance | ✕Slows with size | ✕Slows with size | ✓Graph DB scaling |

## Powerful Features

Transform your codebase into an intelligent knowledge graph that AI assistants can understand and navigate

01

Analyzes code and builds a comprehensive knowledge graph of its components, relationships, and dependencies.

02

Query for callers, callees, class hierarchies, and complex code relationships through natural language.

03

Watches local files for changes and automatically updates the graph in real-time as you code.

04

User-friendly command-line wizard for easy setup. FalkorDB Lite is default (Unix and WSL), with Neo4j available via Docker or native installation.

## Get Started in Minutes

Install CodeGraphContext globally and configure it for your workflow.

1

### Global Installation

Install the package globally via pip to access the `cgc` command everywhere.

### Choose Your Mode

Connect to AI IDEs (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude). Let AI agents query your codebase using natural language.

2

#### 2 Run Setup Wizard

Configures your preferred IDE (Cursor, VS Code, etc.) with the correct paths.

3

#### 3 Start Server

Launches the background server. Your AI assistant is now ready to query the graph!

Bundle Registry

## Pre-indexed CGC Bundles

Browse and download pre-compiled context bundles for popular repositories. Or search servers and community contributions.

Search bundles

Interact with your code graph using plain English. No complex queries or syntax to learn.

Analysis

"Find the class hierarchy for `BaseProcessor`"

Monitoring

"Keep the graph updated for my active development."

Insights

### Code Quality

"Find dead code in my project"

"Show the most complex functions by cyclomatic complexity"

## Loved by Developers

See what the community is saying about the future of code intelligence

"

### Teams Love It

Travel-tech startup Bucketlistt.com has raised Rs 7.6 crore in a seed funding round led by Kairon Capital, with participation from Titan Capital, Divisa Family Office and Kunal Popat. The startup had earlier raised Rs 1.07 crore in a pre-seed angel funding round at a post-money valuation of Rs 10.07 crore. The round saw participation from angel investors including Arvind Choudhar, Aenik Shah, Kartik Khatri, and Yash Mehta. The fresh funds will be utilized to strengthen technology and product, onboard more high-quality operators, and expand beyond Rishikesh, starting with Manali and Bir, and invest in content, organic discovery and distribution partnerships, Bucketlistt said in a press release. Launched last year by Shubham Makhecha, Nitant Desai and Divyam Shah, Bucketlistt.com is a platform to discover and book experiences across India. Its operator platform, OkGhumo, is an operating system for experience providers that digitises bookings, inventory, agents and payments. The Ahmedabad based startup helps travellers discover and book verified travel experiences, from skydiving in Mt. Abu and front row seats at the Ganga Aarti in Rishikesh to dinner with royal families in Jaipur. The company launched in Rishikesh in December 2025. Alongside the marketplace, it runs OkGhumo, a platform that experience providers use to manage bookings, inventory, agents, payments and daily operations. In the last 10 months, Bucketlistt.com and OkGhumo claimed to have together managed more than Rs 22.5 crore in bookings, while Bucketlistt.com has served more than 12,000 customers. About one in five of its customers now comes through word of mouth. Launched in March 2026, OkGhumo has served more than 50,000 customers.
